verdict.rationale: Polar offers shareable hosted Checkout Links that can be emailed to collect online payment, and its automated dunning flow emails customers a Customer Portal link and retries charges on a published 2/5/7/7-day schedule. That approximates payment collection with reminders, but only for checkouts and failed subscription charges. Nothing in the evidence describes creating or sending actual hosted invoices. Missing for 10: a hosted invoice document or invoice-sending feature, reminders for unpaid invoices (rather than failed subscription charges), and invoice due-date or terms configuration for finance ops.
